_PROVENANCE.purpose: Honest diagnosis + improvement of DO (dissolved oxygen) from optics on REAL Sentinel-2 x USGS data. Decomposes DO signal into optics-only vs temperature-only vs combined.
_PROVENANCE.data: data/processed/satellite/drone_wq_pairs.npz (REAL Sentinel-2 L2A B02,B03,B04,B08 paired with REAL same-day USGS/NWIS in-situ WQ).
_PROVENANCE.split: STATION (site_id) GroupKFold — no site shared train/test; pooled out-of-fold predictions.
_PROVENANCE.ci: site-clustered bootstrap (resamples SITES, not rows), 2000 reps; paired delta CI vs shipped baseline.
_PROVENANCE.model: HistGradientBoosting regressor (CPU), same family as the red-edge chl-a study that beat the ViT.
_PROVENANCE.temperature_note: Temp feature = REAL in-situ same-day water temperature, a legitimately available covariate. DO gain attributable to Temp is labeled temperature-driven, NOT optical.

shipped_baselines.note: both use the same 4 bands + station holdout; drone is the pure-optics comparator for the optics-only arm.

A_optics_only.features: 4-band spatial stats + chl/turbidity proxy indices (no temp)

A_optics_only_matched_set.note: optics-only evaluated on the SAME rows as B/C for fair paired deltas

optics_vs_drone_shipped.interpretation: pure-optics GBM vs pure-optics drone ViT, same bands & station holdout. Improved iff new_r2 CI lower bound > drone 0.257.

temp_marginal_C_minus_Aoptics.interpretation: R2 gain from ADDING temperature to optics (paired, same sites). This gain is TEMPERATURE-driven, not new optical signal.

optics_marginal_C_minus_temp.interpretation: R2 gain from ADDING optics on top of temperature (paired). This isolates GENUINE optical DO information beyond temperature.

verdict.optics_vs_drone: IMPROVED: optics-only R2=0.491 (CI lower 0.442) > drone shipped 0.257. Genuine optical DO gain (GBM > ViT, same bands).
verdict.optics_beyond_temp: Optics adds REAL signal beyond temperature: C-B delta=+0.138 CI[+0.097,+0.177] excludes 0.
verdict.temperature_share: Temp-only R2=0.585 vs optics-only R2=0.516 vs combined R2=0.725. Adding temp to optics lifts R2 by +0.210 (CI[+0.178,+0.243]). Any DO 'improvement' from the combined model is largely TEMPERATURE information.

improved_definition: new_r2 (optics-only) CI-lower-bound > shipped drone pure-optics DO R2 0.257, on a station GroupKFold holdout. This is a pure-optics claim; the optics+temp arm is reported but flagged temperature-driven.
